page: Vultr vx1-g-48c-192g-2880s is an enterprise-grade cloud server within the VX1 Cloud Compute family, configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores running at 2.0 GHz on the AMD EPYC x86_64 platform. The system is provisioned with 192 GB of total system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU, and integrates 2880 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and operates entirely without GPU acceleration. Advanced instruction set extensions are available on the processor, including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, SHA-NI, AES, and VAES.

Benchmark measurements indicate top-tier single-core and multi-core compute capability. The instance records a Geekbench single-core score of 2774.0 and a multi-core score of 26519.0, placing it in the top decile for single-threaded tasks and software compilation benchmarks. Memory operations display high write throughput alongside top-tier single-threaded compression performance. In simulated operational tasks, the system delivers strong throughput across Redis SET operations reaching 85 million operations per second, static web serving throughput exceeding 77 GB per second, and rapid CPU-bound token generation on small-to-medium size language models.

From a qualitative cost and architectural perspective, the provision of 48 dedicated physical hardware threads and nearly 3 TB of local NVMe SSD storage provides dense local capacity without incurring external block storage dependencies. The hardware configuration prioritizes raw multi-core throughput and local NVMe storage speeds over extreme memory overprovisioning. Workloads requiring extreme RAM-per-core profiles above 1:4 may require memory-optimized alternatives, while the lack of discrete GPUs limits large-scale parallel matrix computations.

This server profile matches demanding data storage and processing deployments. Primary suitable workloads include production relational database management systems, high-volume Redis or in-memory key-value caching clusters, multi-tenant software build and continuous integration systems, high-concurrency web serving infrastructure, and real-time CPU-driven inference tasks.
description: Vultr vx1-g-48c-192g-2880s is a general-purpose dedicated instance within the VX1 Cloud Compute line, engineered for high-throughput computing and data-heavy environments. Driven by a 2.0 GHz AMD EPYC processor featuring 24 physical cores and 48 dedicated threads on the x86_64 architecture, this instance pairs 192 GB of system memory with 2880 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage and zero GPU accelerators. With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the configuration delivers top-tier performance across single-core and multi-core Geekbench tests, alongside strong results in stress-ng evaluations and static web serving throughput. Extended instruction sets including AVX-512, VNNI, and SHA-NI enhance cryptography, compression, and compilation performance. The substantial NVMe disk capacity and memory allocation support large working sets without third-party network storage bottlenecks. This server is well suited for relational databases, Redis in-memory caches, software compilation pipelines, container orchestration hosts, and CPU-based machine learning inference pipelines.
